datasets: WMT20 shared task on Parallel Corpus Filtering and Alignment
outputs: Translated sentences for the target language
The paper generates translated text outputs in the context of Machine Translation systems for low-resource language pairs.

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate/abbreviated dataset names and consolidated to canonical forms. Removed redundant output descriptions and simplified model names. Added Tatoeba dataset which was mentioned but missing from original extraction.
No changes needed - BLEU and chrF are correctly identified and normalized
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses LaBSE for corpus filtering, not for evaluating generated outputs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - only automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF) were used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving machine translation quality through corpus filtering techniques (LaBSE) and phrase pair injection. It evaluates using standard automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF) but does not conduct human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicate dataset names and overly verbose output descriptions.
